stem: From 1603 to 1867, the position of shogun in Japan was held by members of which family?
options: The Meiji family
The Fujiwara family
The Tokugawa family
The Sumitomo family
explanation: Correct option: (C). Members of the Tokugawa family held the position of shogun from 1603 to 1867. Meiji is the name of the reign restored in 1868; Fujiwara is not the shogunal family of this period; Sumitomo was a later business house (zaibatsu).
